name: Bielke Rental Request Shop
author: bielke

sections.description:
Bielke Rental Request Shop adds a rental catalog workflow to WordPress. Customers can browse rental products, add items to a request list, and submit a non-payment rental request.

Included features:

  • Rental products and product categories
  • Product detail pages with gallery, stock and variant fields
  • Request list / cart system
  • Checkout request form
  • Request management in the WordPress admin
  • Product gallery with media uploads and image URLs
  • Branding, colors and layout settings
  • Cart icon widget and shortcodes
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Create a shop page with [bielke_rental_shop].
  3. Create a request list page with [bielke_rental_shop_cart].
  4. Create a checkout page with [bielke_rental_shop_checkout].
  5. Create a thank-you page with [bielke_rental_shop_thank_you].
  6. Add rental products in the WordPress admin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin process payments?

No. It collects rental requests only.

Which shortcodes are available?

  • [bielke_rental_shop]
  • [bielke_rental_shop_cart]
  • [bielke_rental_shop_checkout]
  • [bielke_rental_shop_thank_you]
  • [bielke_rental_shop_cart_icon]
